arrangement.notes: Arrangement with sparse verses and strong hooks, minimal variation, dark mood typical for Phonk style.

event_markers.label: Hook
event_markers.reason: Introduce strong hook energy with samples

event_markers.label: Verse 1
event_markers.reason: Sparse verses with dark mood delivery

event_markers.label: Final Hook
event_markers.reason: Peak energy hook with maximum impact

sound_intent.overall_timbre: Dark, gritty, with warm analog textures
sample_techniques: Looping for chord sustain and presence

routing_intent.drums: sent to main bus, parallel compression for punch
routing_intent.bass: direct to bass bus with sidechain to kick
routing_intent.vocal: dry/wet controlled to maintain clarity, sliced samples routed individually

track_roles.drums: rhythmic foundation, sample sliced percussive elements
track_roles.bass: low-end groove with granular sample manipulation

designer_intent.arrangement_style: Minimal variation with stark energy contrast between verses and hooks to emphasize hooks
designer_intent.channel_naming: Channels named after sample chopping techniques such as Slicer, Chopper, Granulator, and Looper

presetor_intent.preset_focus: Presets that enhance grit and dark warmth with sample manipulation effects

sensei_drum.brief: Design rhythmic patterns that use sliced drum samples with sparse filling during verses and high energy hooks.

bass_generator.brief: Produce granular-processed bass layers that enhance groove with minimal note complexity.

harmony_generator.brief: Generate looped chord pads with minimal movement to support the dark atmosphere.

melody_generator.brief: Create atmospheric melodic phrases using granular sample chops, focusing on texture not melody complexity.

ai_designer.brief: Arrange sections with minimal variation, emphasizing sparse verses and strong, catchy hooks.

presetor.brief: Select and tweak presets to produce warm, dark timbres suited for Phonk sample manipulations.

songgps.brief: Guide arrangement energy profile to create clear contrast between low-energy verses and high-energy hooks.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix channels to retain raw sample texture with clarity, apply sidechain compression to maintain groove.
